purpose: Extract an explicit compact field function from a kernel trained on real magnetic measurements.
distillation_targets: Predictions of the real-data-trained teacher at actual training positions; model outputs, not independent measurements.
test_reuse: Exploratory reuse of Aalto trials already scored in earlier work. No fresh confirmatory test or significance claim.
units: reference Invensense numerical recording units; not independently calibrated SI

data_provenance.citation: Solin, Kok, Wahlstrom, Schon, and Sarkka (2018), Modeling and interpolation of the ambient magnetic field by Gaussian processes.
data_provenance.licence_note: No explicit licence file was present in the pinned upstream tree. Upstream requests attribution; do not infer additional redistribution permissions.

protocol.selection: Minimum basis count within 5% of teacher source-validation RMSE; break ties by RMSE; if none qualify report failure and best-error fallback.
protocol.fitting_targets: Kernel teacher predictions at training positions only.

held_out_hole_and_alignment.units: reference Invensense numerical recording units; not independently calibrated SI

derivative_scope: Analytic sensitivities of fitted functions; no independently measured field derivatives or currents are available.
